text:
Predicates:
ScriptEditor(x, y) ::: x is the script editor for y.
WorkingTitle(y, z) ::: y has the working title z.
Series(y) ::: y is a series.
Premises:
ScriptEditor(AndrewCollins, Badults) ::: Andrew Collins was the script editor for Badults.
WorkingTitle(Badults, "The Secret Dude Society") ::: Badults had the working title "The Secret Dude Society".
Series(Badults) ::: Badults is a series.
Conclusion:
ScriptEditor(AndrewCollins, Badults) ∧ WorkingTitle(Badults, "The Secret Dude Society") → ScriptEditor(AndrewCollins, y) ∧ WorkingTitle(y, "The Secret Dude Society") ::: If Andrew Collins was the script editor for Badults and Badults had the working title "The Secret Dude Society", then Andrew Collins was the script editor for a series with that working title.
